query_normalized: predicting the impact of composition on the band gap of perovskite materials materials science
rationale: This paper directly addresses the user's question by establishing a specific mechanism (steric engineering via bond angles) that links material composition to the optical band gap in perovskites, satisfying acceptance criteria (a) for same-mechanism evidence and (b) for measuring the dependent variable (band gap) as a function of the independent variable (composition/structural features).
